summary: Batch 3 (Activation Module 3 — Building the Fundraising Strategy Plan and Initiating Plan Review) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 2/2 PASS (new comprehensive Batch 3 e2e + Batch 2 regression). One CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG found and fixed in-place: /app/frontend/src/App.js referenced <StrategyReviewPage /> in a route but never imported the component, which caused a React runtime error 'StrategyReviewPage is not defined' that took down the ENTIRE frontend (any route rendered a red uncaught-error overlay, including /login and Module 3). Added the missing import line. After the fix, /strategy-review/{invalid-token} correctly renders sr-invalid, and /app/activation/self-guided/module/3 renders activation-module3 with the correct hero 'Building the Fundraising Strategy Plan and Initiating Plan Review', intro copy 'Turn the Board's Ideas Into One Fundraising Strategy', planning counts line '2 Board Members Invited · 1 Responses Received · 1 Waiting · 1 Responses That Will Be Included', strategy status pill 'READY FOR BOARD REVIEW · v2', full strategy text visible with 'FUNDRAISING STRATEGY PLAN' + 'Activation Test Nonprofit', review counts '2 Invited · 1 Review Received · 1 Waiting', warning text 'You have received 1 of 2 Board reviews...', and CONTINUE TO MODULE 4 CTA. Real Claude generation was triggered ONCE and returned a Draft in ~50s. Generated strategy contains all 15 required section headings in strict order (EXECUTIVE SUMMARY through 15. NEXT STEP: REVIEW AND ADOPT THE PLAN), the real org name 'Activation Test Nonprofit', the $500,000 fundraising goal from intake, no 'AI' mention, no [PLACEHOLDER]/[ORGANIZATION] tokens, no 'Carol' misattribution (Carol did not complete Module 2), and section 6 references the full KNOW/LIKE/TRUST/ASK/FOLLOW UP/STEWARD framework. Edit + Save persists as Draft, Approve moves to 'Ready for Board Review · v(n+1)', sending review BEFORE approval returns 409 (verified for both Draft and NONE states). Send-review to Alice uses exact deterministic subject 'Please Review Our Fundraising Strategy Plan | Activation Test Nonprofit' and body starting with 'Thank you for contributing your ideas' and containing 'developed the Fundraising Strategy Plan for Board review'; secure /strategy-review/{token} link auto-inserted; after send, participant.review_status flips SENT with last_review_sent_at and review_version stamped. Public /api/strategy-review/{token} serves without auth, returns organization_name, submitted flag, strategy_text (frozen version — verified to contain the version-1 test marker even after re-approve to v2), and EXACTLY the three review options verbatim. Option 2/3 without discussion_points → 422; missing contribution → 422; invalid position → 422; valid submission → 201; resubmission → 409; invalid token → 404. Founder VIEW REVIEW returns Alice's original position/discussion/contribution/support verbatim (no AI summary/ranking). Reminder to Carol works: reminder preview subject 'Reminder: Please Review Our Fundraising Strategy Plan' with SAME secure token as initial; reminder on NOT SENT/REVIEWED both correctly 409. Review-progress {invited:2, received:1, waiting:1}. Version safety: after founder cleaned marker and re-approved to v2, Alice's frozen public link still serves v1 text (marker preserved) and her review_version stays pinned to v1. Module 2 data intact — Alice's original planning response still returned by /api/activation/participants/{id}/response. Strategy status remains 'Ready for Board Review' throughout — nothing marked 'Adopted'. Regression: test_batch2_activation_planning.py passes in 4.9s. HTTP smoke on /app/recruitment/self-guided, /app/reactivation/self-guided, module 2 and module 3 all return 200. End state (per handoff instructions): strategy Ready for Board Review v2 (clean, no test markers in founder view), Alice REVIEWED with realistic supportive-with-suggestions review and pinned to v1, Carol SENT (initial + reminder recorded).

minor.issue: Founder notification email is attempted with subject 'Fundraising Strategy Review Received | Alice ...' and deep link /app/activation/self-guided/module/3?reviewer={id}. Resend test-mode rejects @example.com recipients so the actual send fails, but the code correctly wraps it in try/except so the review submission still returns 201. Explicitly permitted by spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing import for StrategyReviewPage caused React runtime error 'StrategyReviewPage is not defined' that broke the ENTIRE app (every route rendered the uncaught-error overlay, including /login). Fixed in-place by adding `import StrategyReviewPage from "@/funnels/StrategyReviewPage";` right after the PlanningFormPage import.

action_items: Main agent: acknowledge the App.js import fix. Consider adding an ESLint no-undef check to CI so a route that references an unimported component fails the build instead of shipping. This same class of bug wiped every page including /login.
critical_code_review_comments: activation_planning_routes.py review_version_text falls back to the latest approved version if the pinned version is not found — safe in practice because approved_versions only grows. Correctly preserves per-participant version pinning verified end-to-end (Alice's marker preserved after founder cleaned and re-approved to v2).
send_review only stamps review_version onto the participant when review_version is falsy — so subsequent reminders do NOT change which version the reviewer sees. Correct.
public POST /api/strategy-review/{token} uses an atomic update_one with review_status != REVIEWED guard and returns 409 on race — good.
approve-review guards status to {Draft, Ready for Board Review} — allows re-approve for versioning, blocks approving when NONE — correct.
send_review blocks when strategy.status != 'Ready for Board Review' with 409 — correct for both NONE and Draft states.
reminder-only allowed when review_status == 'SENT' — NOT SENT and REVIEWED both correctly 409.
strategy_display renders all 15 headings from STRATEGY_SECTIONS in strict order — verified in-body.
No mongodb _id leakage in any endpoint — all queries use projection {'_id': 0}.

GENERATION_TYPES['activation_fundraising_strategy'] schema has 16 fields (executive_summary + 15 numbered sections) matching STRATEGY_SECTIONS. AI note explicitly forbids inventing donors/businesses/foundations/statistics, forbids AI mention, forbids assigning final individual responsibilities in Module 3, forbids assigning one member's ideas to another. Verified in output.
One-liner fix in App.js was a shipping blocker: an unimported component in a Route brings down the whole app. Consider tightening the lint config to catch this at build time.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 3 fully verified. Comprehensive Batch 3 e2e lives at /app/backend/tests/test_batch3_module3_strategy.py and reuses the existing seeded activation-tester account. The test is idempotent: it skips fresh AI generation if a Draft already exists, so re-runs finish in ~5s. The one bug found (missing App.js import for StrategyReviewPage) was a build/lint hygiene miss that manifested as a global runtime error — it is now fixed. rca of the issue: Root cause of the frontend outage: /app/frontend/src/App.js line 102 registers `<Route path='/strategy-review/:token' element={<StrategyReviewPage />} />` but no matching `import StrategyReviewPage from '@/funnels/StrategyReviewPage'` was ever added when the Batch 3 UI was wired in. React attempts to render the App component tree, hits the undefined identifier when constructing the Routes children, and throws ReferenceError: StrategyReviewPage is not defined synchronously during App render — which the CRA dev-error overlay catches and displays as a red uncaught-runtime-errors screen on EVERY route (because App itself fails to render). Reproduction: navigate to any URL under REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — screen shows red overlay. Fix (applied): added `import StrategyReviewPage from '@/funnels/StrategyReviewPage';` on the line immediately after PlanningFormPage import. Verified post-fix: /strategy-review/{invalid} renders sr-invalid; /login renders form; /app/activation/self-guided/module/3 renders full workspace.
